tickets.title: P2-134: the abandon announcement fires once per episode and names the reason it observed
tickets.defect: ATM_STOP_MOVE_ABANDONED is emitted on EVERY monitor sweep once StopModifyAttempts has reached MaxStopModifyAttempts, from a line whose own text promises 'not asking again for this bracket'. Measured live 2026-08-16: four identical lines in twenty seconds, and in the suite 17 lines across 20 sweeps. The attempt COUNTER is correctly capped -- that half is P1-130 working -- but the abandon branch sits on the path every sweep takes, so the ANNOUNCEMENT of giving up repeats forever. Second half: the message asserts '3 consecutive stop moves were refused by the provider', which is false on this path. StopModifyAttempts is incremented from TWO different failures: RequestStopMove increments when ModifyStopPrice could not find a live order (the provider was never asked -- nothing was submitted), and ReconcileStopFromBroker increments when a move WAS sent and the provider is not holding the price (a genuine refusal). The text asserts the second cause for both. Today the ABSENT and TERMINAL failures produce byte-identical messages.
tickets.spec:
Two changes in DynamicAtmManager.cs, plus one new field on ActiveBracket.

(1) ANNOUNCE ONCE PER EPISODE. Add a bool to ActiveBracket that records that the give-up line has already been said for this bracket. In RequestStopMove, the branch that logs ATM_STOP_MOVE_ABANDONED must log only when that flag is false, then set it. It must STILL return false every time, so the behaviour of the bounded retry is unchanged -- only the logging is suppressed.

(2) THE LATCH CLEARS WHEN THE CONDITION RESOLVES, NEVER ON A TIMER. The condition is StopModifyAttempts >= MaxStopModifyAttempts and it resolves in exactly one place: ReconcileStopFromBroker, where ATM_STOP_MOVE_CONFIRMED sets StopModifyAttempts = 0. Clear the flag there, in the same statement group. Do NOT clear it on a time interval and do NOT clear it anywhere else -- a bracket that recovers and later fails again must be able to announce a SECOND time, because that second failure is on a position the operator believes is being trailed.

(3) NAME THE REASON THAT WAS OBSERVED. Add a string field to ActiveBracket holding the last observed stop-move failure. Set it at every site that spends the budget: the three failing branches of ModifyStopPrice (order not on the account at all; order present but no longer live; the attempt threw) and the ATM_STOP_CHANGE_IGNORED branch of ReconcileStopFromBroker. The abandon message must then state what was OBSERVED -- N attempts failed, and the last observed reason -- instead of asserting 'refused by the provider'. On the ModifyStopPrice paths the word 'refused' must not appear at all, because nothing was submitted. Keep the rest of the existing message: the price the stop is left at, and that it will not trail.

ModifyStopPrice currently returns bool and logs its own diagnosis. Report the reason back to RequestStopMove so the give-up line can quote it. Changing its signature is fine -- RequestStopMove is its only caller and is granted below as a region for exactly that reason.

Do not change MaxStopModifyAttempts, do not change when the counter is incremented, and do not touch the ATM_STOP_ORDER_NOT_FOUND messages themselves -- P1-133 pinned those and they have their own tests.

regions.note: Add the announcement latch and the last-observed-reason field beside the counter they belong to. ActiveBracket is serialised into the bridge's API payload, so keep the types simple (bool and string).

regions.anchor: private bool ModifyStopPrice(Account account, string orderName, double newStopPrice)
regions.note: The three failing branches each know exactly what was observed: absent entirely, present but not live, or threw. Report that back to the caller. Do NOT alter the ATM_STOP_ORDER_NOT_FOUND text -- P1-133 pinned both variants and TestAtm_P1133_AbsentAndTerminalStopsSayDifferentThings asserts they differ.

regions.anchor: private bool RequestStopMove(Account account, ActiveBracket bracket, double newStopPrice, string reason)
regions.note: Holds the abandon branch AND the ModifyStopPrice call site. It is granted as a region because it is the CALLER of a method whose signature changes -- P1-133 cost four identical rounds by granting the callee and not the caller.

regions.anchor: private void ReconcileStopFromBroker(Account account, ActiveBracket bracket)
regions.note: Two things here: the CONFIRMED branch resets the counter and must clear the latch in the same place, and the CHANGE_IGNORED branch is the one failure where the provider really did decline -- record that as the observed reason.

expect_green: P2-134: and says it EXACTLY once per episode
P2-134: neither message claims the provider REFUSED anything
P2-134: and the give-up line reports the reason it OBSERVED
